{{Quotation|game|The switchback route that runs along the ridge of [[Abaddon's Mouth (outpost)|Abaddon's Mouth]] is known to any who have ventured here as '''Hell's Precipice'''. One look into the caldera of the furious volcano will explain why.}}

[[Hell's Precipice (outpost)|Hell's Precipice]] is a [[mission]] [[outpost]]. This outpost has no exit portals.

==Getting There==
*The mission [[Abaddon's Mouth]] will bring you here.

==Mission==
*[[Hell's Precipice]]
**This mission is the twenty fifth and final mission in the [[Prophecies campaign]] and the third and final mission in the [[Ring of Fire Islands]] region.
